title: Novabase's Ministry of Health client gives it the right vertical and sovereignty exposure
content:
Novabase's qualifying fact is a client: the Portuguese Ministry of Health. That single relationship puts the firm in the right vertical and gives it the right sovereignty exposure, because a national health ministry is exactly the kind of body whose records must stay under its own control and remain auditable after the fact.

Everything else about the firm is unresearched, including its open-source posture and stack, and even its Portuguese headcount is marked unverified. The lead is therefore qualified on exposure and nothing else, which is why it sits at priority 3.

The reason to keep it is that vertical exposure is the hardest of the qualifying signals to acquire. A firm with the right stack and no sovereignty-exposed clients has to go and win one; a firm with a health-ministry relationship and an unknown stack only has to be screened.
